naming: Names are prefixed with PyNEXUS and must not be treated as official IAMC variable identifiers

hydrogen_demand.description: Configured annual hydrogen demand = 50,000 kg/day multiplied by complete calendar days. Same demand for every registered scenario.

unserved_hydrogen_stage_a.description: Annual unmet hydrogen in physical adequacy-minimising Stage A. From previously independently verified WP4 synthesis.

unserved_fraction_stage_a.description: Stage A annual unmet hydrogen divided by annual configured demand; a dimensionless fraction, not percent.

delivered_hydrogen_stage_a.description: Configured demand less annual Stage A unserved hydrogen, not measured plant output or Stage B production.

reference_wind_resource.description: Annual 150-MW REFERENCE wind-availability potential from WP4 weather before intervention scaling. Repeated in each scenario to preserve the source-series definition; NOT the available wind after W nameplate upgrade.

reference_wind_capacity_factor.description: Annual mean wind output divided by 150-MW REFERENCE installed wind nameplate. Common per weather year; does not represent W scenario upgraded capacity factor.

adequacy_benefit_vs_baseline.description: Within the same weather year: 100 * (baseline Stage A unmet-demand fraction minus this scenario's Stage A unmet-demand fraction). Finite model contrast, not observed intervention impact.

electrolyser_storage_interaction.description: Only for E+S: 100 * (E share + S share - baseline share - E+S share). Controlled model interaction; not a causal engineering estimate.
